question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Forthcoming
solution:
The correct answer is: **Past**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"forthcoming"** means something that is about to happen or appear soon; it can also imply being willing to divulge information. (आगामी)

 
 
• **Example:** The **forthcoming **events were announced during the meeting.
 
 
 
• **"Past"** refers to something that has already happened or existed before the present time. (भूतकाल)
 
 
• **Example:** She often reminisces about her **past **experiences in the city.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'forthcoming'** is **'past'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Large** (बड़ा): Of considerable or relatively great size, extent, or capacity.

 
 
• **Example:** The **large **room could accommodate over fifty people.
 
 
 
• **Extensive** (विस्तृत): Covering or affecting a large area; having a wide scope.
 
 
• **Example:** The library has an **extensive **collection of books.
 
 
 
• **Adventurous** (साहसी): Willing to take risks or to try out new methods, ideas, or experiences.
 
 
• **Example:** She is known for her **adventurous **spirit and love for exploring new places.
